description: This file defines the IStreamIdMapper interface, which provides a method for mapping StreamId objects to GrainId keys within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IStreamIdMapper
classes.description: Interface for components that map a StreamId to a GrainId.Key.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainId.Key associated with a given StreamId, based on provided grain bindings.
